newsitem.title: JAPAN: H.I.S. says new airline to go public in five years.
newsitem.headline: H.I.S. says new airline to go public in five years.

text.p: H.I.S. Co Ltd said on Monday that the domestic airline it is setting up would go public within five years.
It said the name of the new airline would be Skymark Airlines Co Ltd.

H.I.S., a Tokyo-based discount airline ticket agency, announced in October that it planned to start regular domestic flights in two or three years in competition with the three major airlines dominating the Japanese market.
It said it plans to apply early next year for a government licence to operate the domestic airline.
